methodological_scope: Comparison of two independently implemented approximations of wind and water-current response; this tolerance does not replace the contract's separate per-axis kinematic divergence report.

proposed_acceptance.primary_metric: relative Euclidean divergence between Node and VRX environment-induced N/E displacement vectors
proposed_acceptance.environment_induced_displacement: For each simulator, subtract the matched wind/current-disabled trajectory from the wind/current-enabled trajectory using the same seed, reset, and action trace.
proposed_acceptance.direction_consistency: Required at every checkpoint; additionally, no N or E component may reverse sign when the corresponding Node component magnitude is at least 0.5 m.
proposed_acceptance.anti_compounding_condition: The 30% vector-divergence ceiling must hold independently at 30, 60, and 120 seconds. A terminal pass cannot hide an earlier runaway. All checkpoint values and terminal magnitude divergence are reported.
proposed_acceptance.aggregation_rule: Every held-out seed must satisfy every environment criterion; no averaging across seeds for pass/fail.

boundedness_assessment.observed: Normalized divergence decreased from 19.5% at approximately 9.6 seconds to 4.01% vector divergence at approximately 112 seconds; it did not compound over the measured horizon.
boundedness_assessment.physical_basis: Both implementations use dissipative linear/quadratic relative-flow forces, so velocities approach bounded responses. An absolute position offset can accumulate, but normalized disturbance-induced displacement divergence is expected to approach a bounded ratio rather than grow exponentially.
boundedness_assessment.why_30_percent: The ceiling is 10.5 percentage points above the observed short-horizon magnitude gap, accommodates transient and seed-to-seed variation between independent approximations, and remains strict enough to reject a material force-scale or direction error. The checkpoint and direction rules prevent a permissive terminal-only pass.

separate_reporting.kinematic: Report contract per-axis N, E, yaw, u, v, and r absolute divergence and first-divergence step at the existing 1e-4 threshold.
separate_reporting.environment: Report paired environment-induced vector divergence, magnitude divergence, and direction difference at 30, 60, and 120 seconds under the proposed criteria.

execution_guard: Do not run full held-out Gate 7 episodes until this proposed tolerance is explicitly approved.
